$$
a(n) =
\begin{cases}
25, & \text{if } n = 0 \\

50, & \text{if } n = 6 \\

\end{cases}

- **Recursive step for $ n \geq 9 $ and $ n \mod 3 = 0 $**: The value at $ n $ is the same as the value at $ n - 6 $, which ensures the pattern continues.
